items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: My cousin Pratt, he played with Chris Kelly.

ctx.x: Eddie Morris, you say, lives right across the street. Right across the street on that side there. I remember when Kid Howard lived there. Howard used to live in H Block down there. Yeah, sir. And Jim and George Lurit. Jim used to live down there, all of them. Yeah, right there. Can you tell us about anyone in your family that ever played music that your father... Yeah, no.
My cousin Pratt, he played with Chris Kelly. He's dead. He played with Chris Kelly. He used to play with Papa Celestan too. And he played with Kid René.
